Mobile Filesystem Inspector

Detect devices

Android (adb) and iOS (libimobiledevice) devices over USB, emulator, or TCP. The list refreshes automatically; Detect forces a re-check (including root/jailbreak).

Wireless debugging → “Pair device with pairing code” gives the pairing host:port and code above. After pairing, Connect using the host:port shown on the main Wireless debugging screen (a different port).

Connect a device to begin
Plug in an Android or iOS device (or start an emulator / simulator) — it appears here automatically.
IDNamePlatformTransportStateRoot / JB

Installed apps

Apps on the selected device. Detect a device first, then click “List apps”. Pick one to prefill Extract.
